title: Profile
description: A named selection policy. A profile filters what the engine may propose; it never overrides a dont_touch decision and never lifts the destructive exclusion from the safe plan.

include_risk.description: Risk levels this profile is willing to include.

exclude_destructive.description: Whether destructive tweaks are excluded. The safe profile must set this true.

tweaks.description: Explicit tweak ids this profile always considers, in addition to what the engine recommends.

params.description: Parameter overrides keyed by tweak id.
